text: adjectives Aromatic, Floral, Herbaceous, Lingering-finish, Musty, Nutty, Short-finished, Smooth, Sweet HUE TERMS USED TO DESCRIBE THE LIQUOR The color of tea ranges from pale gold to dark purple-black. As one might imagine, dark, thick black and pu-erh teas brew the darkest color. Slender, needle-like black tea leaves produce red-hued coppery colors. Oolong teas from China are golden/greenish/blue, while Taiwanese oolongs tend toward tawny golden brown. Chinese green teas are light yellow or pale green, and Japanese green teas surprise with vivid yellow-green or emerald green colors. White tea has been likened to the clear color of the full moon.
